parts.label: f
parts.text: (f) There are 12 balls in a bag, n of them are blue. A ball is taken from the bag at random and replaced. The probability that the ball is blue is p . 6 more blue balls are added to the bag. A ball is taken from the bag at random. The probability that this ball is blue is 2 p . Find the value of p . p = ................................................. [4]

content.tex: There are 12 balls in a bag, \(n\) of them are blue. A ball is taken from the bag at random and replaced. The probability that the ball is blue is \(p\) .
6 more blue balls are added to the bag. A ball is taken from the bag at random. The probability that this ball is blue is \(2p\) .
